about: The backdrop sweep (owner D10, light work): the town's edges and feel from a player's eye (5.5 st over the ground). Make: lune run tools/bake/main.luau; lune run tools/bake/editor_ground.luau; lune run tools/bake/attractions.luau; lune run tools/bake/backdrop.luau; then each tools/bake/<venue>.luau (skylift, sewers, neighbourhood_shop, bowl_lane, corner_store, lounge_classic); lune run tools/review/export.luau --out build/review/scene.json; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/scene.json --views docs/renders/backdrop_sweep/views.json --out build/review/backdrop_sweep --threads 2. Views marked aboveGround are inside the review's fine terrain grid; the others are outside it (render.py would clamp to the grid's edge there) and carry an absolute eye height, 5.5 st over World/Height. The offline renderer draws the town's 95 trees as nothing (uploaded meshes) and does not light the lamps by day. Roblox axes: +X is game-west, +Z north.
